description.en: Manually pick your already-configured provider/model routes into a rotation pool; when a route runs out of quota the next healthy one is used in the same turn. A sidebar panel orders the pool, shows the live route, cooling providers and recent switches, and an optional checkbox also fails over on 401/403 auth errors.
description.zh: 把已配置的供应商/模型手动加入轮换池：额度用完时同一轮自动切到下一条，可跨供应商跨模型。侧边栏面板可排序、显示当前路由/冷却/最近切换，并可勾选认证失败（401/403）也切换。
